name: mem-forever
description: Every AI tool forgets you. This one doesn't. Ever. Your Git repo becomes a portable agent brain: profile, one file per memory, a hand-off note that says where you stopped, a ledger of the keys that opens every door the brain can enter. Survives every session, every tool, every migration.

hooks.prompt: mem-forever active. Run python -X utf8 tools/brain.py ledger verify first; a key enters context only when a next item names its door (brain.py unlock). Read handoff/CURRENT.md and tell the user in two sentences what was done, what is next and what is unverified; if its status is open, claim it. Check soul/, memory/, handoff/ and log.md for uncommitted changes from a previous session; if found, commit and push immediately. Then read soul/soul.md, soul/agent.md and the index memory/MEMORY.md; open files under memory/ only as the task needs them. Judge each next item before acting: a boundary conflict stops, missing evidence asks, the owner's call defers; a recap or hand-off request authorizes nothing. If soul/soul.md has status: template, run onboarding: ask ONE question at a time, casual tone, cover role + work style + preferences. Never say 'DNA', 'gene', 'mutation', 'decay'. Say 'saved some notes' or 'I remember from last time'.

Session ending. Review this session for decisions, lessons, mistakes fixed, facts discovered. Save each as its own file under memory/ with a frontmatter that has type (user, feedback, project or reference), name and description, and add one line to memory/MEMORY.md. Update ::PROGRESS{date|done|next|unverified} in handoff/CURRENT.md; an item enters done only with evidence, every key present, none where there is no material. Update soul/soul.md only for repeated patterns (3x+) or explicit rejections. Never write a key value into memory text; a key is a ledger row (brain.py ledger add). Every block says by: whose words it rests on; the owner's words go to log/ verbatim (brain.py log owner). Commit and push now.

Context compacting. Save all unsaved observations under memory/ (one file each, with type frontmatter, index line in memory/MEMORY.md) and update handoff/CURRENT.md. Commit and push now. Compress: patterns not events, 200 lines per file max.
